summary: Gravel car park beside the freeway, with parkland and no homes near.
reasons: Cars parked and tyre tracks on gravel
Freeway noise is a flag only

best_section.where: Northern half of the gravel car park, east of the freeway shared path

drivers.seclusion: Backs onto open parkland and trees; the only building within 23 m is a non-dwelling water-utility shed. Nearest homes are not in view.
drivers.access_and_room: Open gravel surface about 15 m wide and 100 m long with vehicle tracks; room for a van to park clear.
drivers.traffic: Busy freeway 20 m west, separated by a shared path; noise only.
drivers.convention: Several cars parked in both images; mapped car park, free, open access.

flags: Slope about 2% mean, 7% max near the entry
Entry from the roadway not clear in imagery
sun_shade: Mostly open; trees shade the south end and the eastern edge in the afternoon.
cannot_judge: Signs and time limits on site
How the car park joins the road
